remarks: This bright and welcoming 2 bedroom, 2 bath home features plenty of natural light, an enclosed sunroom and new windows, along with a newly installed air conditioning unit for year round comfort. Updates completed in 2020 included kitchen appliances, resurfaced countertops, flooring, interior and exterior paint, lighting and bathroom fixtures. Outside, a gated backyard and large tool shed offer extra space for storage, gardening supplies and projects.
